proposition: Back in Isfahan he took up teaching, intending a quiet contemplative life (gūsha-nishīnī), until Pīr-Muḥammad b. ʿUmar-Shaykh, Temür's grandson and governor of Fars, summoned him to Shiraz and made him a member of his court (c. 810-12/1408-9).

mediation.note: no source is cited for this passage; timeline dates are marked 'c.'
